messages:
Alice Chen: Anyone else hitting import errors for the JS SDK in edge runtimes after the 0.9.2 publish?
Ben Ruiz: Yep — Cloudflare worker build failed with 'Cannot find module @redwood/inference' when using `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'`. Works fine in Node dev.
Carla Gomez: Huh. I remember the release pipeline switched the Rollup output to .cjs only to fix a bundler bug. Did we forget to emit .mjs and the source maps?
Ben Ruiz: Looks like `dist/` only has index.cjs and index.cjs.map (but package.json points `module` => dist/index.mjs). Vite/ESM loaders try to resolve .mjs and choke. Error from Vite: "Failed to resolve import \"@redwood/inference\" from ..."
Alice Chen: Oof. That explains why Edge (which enforces ESM) breaks but Node CJS consumers are fine.
Jordan Park: Quick check of the published package:
```
{
  "name": "@redwood/inference",
  "version": "0.9.2",
  "main": "dist/index.cjs",
  "module": "dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "dist/index.mjs",
      "require": "dist/index.cjs"
    }
  }
}
```
But dist/index.mjs and dist/index.d.ts are missing. Only index.cjs exists.
Carla Gomez: Looks like the publish step used the CJS-only artifact by mistake. The build script sets `formats: ['cjs']` on the Rollup config in the CI job unless `NODE_ENV=esm` is set. CI changed environments last week.
Ben Ruiz: Workarounds: pin to 0.9.1 or use `import pkg from '@redwood/inference/dist/index.cjs'` (not great). For Cloudflare Workers you can also force a bundler to include the CJS file, but that's hacky.
Alice Chen: For immediate triage: can someone republish 0.9.3 with both .mjs and .cjs outputs plus source maps and types? Also include a browser field for edge bundlers and ensure .map files are published.
Carla Gomez: I'll take it. Plan: revert CI env change, update rollup to emit ['cjs','es'], ensure `declaration: true` in tsconfig and copy .d.ts and .map files to dist before publish. I'll run a canary publish to npm tag `canary-edge`.
Jordan Park: Also add a check in `release` job that verifies published tarball contains module and types: `npm pack` + `tar -tf` to assert files present.
sam-bot: build-bot: Canary publish 0.9.3-canary.0 succeeded -> https://npmjs.com/package/@redwood/inference/v/0.9.3-canary.0 :rocket:
Ben Ruiz: Thanks. I'll validate by deploying to staging Workers and running the Vite app. Also will check sourcemaps are usable in Sentry.
Alice Chen: Heads up for docs: update upgrade notes about pinning specifiers for a short window and mention the fix.
Carla Gomez: ETA for stable republish 0.9.3 later today. I'll post logs here.
Ben Ruiz: Verified on staging — import works, sourcemaps and types resolve. :thumbsup:
Alice Chen: Awesome, thanks team.
Carla Gomez: Follow-up items: add unit test that unpacks `npm pack` and asserts presence of .mjs, .cjs, .d.ts, and .map. I'll open PR.
Jordan Park: I'll add a note to the release checklist to run the tarball sanity check.
Alice Chen: Closing loop once 0.9.3 is live and SDK samples updated.
